## TemplateManager.getGDescription() method

Gets a command description for Telegram menu.

**Signature:**

```typescript
getGDescription(key: string, AGBaseId?: string, ALang?: string, AScope?: string, data?: Record<string, any>): string;
```

**Returns:**

string

Rendered description string, or empty string if not found

## Remarks

Retrieves the compiled description function for the specified template, scope, and language, then executes it with the provided data.

## Example


```typescript
const desc = tm.getGDescription("start", "default", "en")
// => "Start the bot"
```
